entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for a VeloBand Pulse I recently purchased.
I can certainly help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's more of a preference. It works fine, but it's just not what I was looking for. Now, I know I've had it for 19 days, but I did try to return it earlier.
Okay, can you tell me more about that?

Of course. I tried to process the return on your website about ten days ago. But there was a persistent website error. I'm pretty sure your whole system was down because nothing would load. I even took a screenshot. Because of that, I couldn't print the return label.

I understand. Let me check our system logs for that timeframe... Yes, it looks like we did have a known service outage that day that affected the returns portal. I appreciate you letting me know and for being so patient.

Actually, even without that issue, I'm just checking our official return policy now... and it looks like all our items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you're still well within the window.

Oh, 90 days? That's fantastic. Well, since I did run into that trouble with the system being down, and had to call in, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase for the inconvenience?

That's a reasonable question. While I'm glad we can get this return processed for a full refund, I'm not authorized to provide discount codes for this type of situation. But I can assure you I will get the return label sent to your email immediately.
Okay, I understand. A full refund was the main goal, so that works for me. Thank you for approving it.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with the prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
